snippet.title: Audio Trip: Neon Disco | Meta Quest & SteamVR
snippet.description:
Dance your way through neon lights with Audio Trip’s hottest DLC yet! This sizzling new pack features 5 electrifying tracks that will have you moving like never before. From retro-funk grooves to smooth house vibes, every beat pulses with energy. Feel the heat, glide through the beat, and lose yourself in the rhythm.

Featuring our team's favorite choreography yet, this DLC delivers a fresh challenge for veterans and newcomers alike. Whether you're chasing perfect scores or just vibing to the beat, it’s time to step into the spotlight and own the dance floor.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/826540/Audio_Trip/
